## What is email marketing software for restaurants?


**[Email marketing software](https://www.mailmodo.com/) for restaurants helps food businesses manage customer communication via email. These tools often come with features like drag-and-drop builders, automation (e.g., birthday offers, reservation follow-ups), list segmentation, analytics, and integrations with[POS systems](https://posapt.au/) or CRMs.**


They are essential for:


- Promoting daily or seasonal offers
- Sending reservation reminders
- Collecting feedback through post-visit surveys
- Rewarding loyalty or VIP guests
- Launching new menus or events


## 10 best email marketing software for restaurants


Here’s a breakdown of each of the[best email marketing platforms](https://www.emailers.io/) , what it does best and why it might be the right fit for your restaurant or food-service brand.


---


### 1. Mailmodo


Mailmodo is an[AI email marketing platform](https://www.mailmodo.com/) that helps restaurants run data driven email campaigns to increase reservations . Its AI campaign planner provides actionable recommendations for timing, content, and audience targeting, helping restauran optimize each email without spending hours on manual setup.


Its AI template generator makes creating visually appealing, high-converting emails fast and easy. Simply describe what you want, like “Weekend brunch special” or “Holiday menu launch,” and the AI builds a complete email template with layouts, visuals, and content ideas tailored for restaurants.


Your AI Assistant for Everything Email Marketing


**Pricing:**


- Free plan available
- Lite plan at $39/month
- Pro at $79/month
- Max at $159/month


**Ease of use:** Clean interface, intuitive campaign builder, helpful templates tailored for engagement.


**Features:**


- AMP interactive emails
- Automation workflows
- Template library
- In-depth analytics
- Form and calendar embeds


**Why it’s suitable for startups:** Great for brands looking to boost engagement without building landing pages.


**Customer feedback and support:** Users appreciate the strong customer support and focus on innovation.


**Startup ranking:** 4.6/5 – Unique value for engagement-focused campaigns.


### 2. Brevo (formerly Sendinblue)


Brevo is a complete communication suite offering email, SMS, automation, and CRM features. It’s great for restaurants that want centralized control over customer messaging.


**Pricing:**


- Free plan available at $0/month, limited to 300 emails/day
- Starter at from $8.08/month, suitable for growing businesses
- Business at from $16.17/month, ideal for marketing managers and ecommerce pros
- Enterprise at custom pricing, tailored solutions for large needs


**Ease of use:** Beginner-friendly, with drag-and-drop design and pre-built workflows.


**Features:**


- Email + SMS marketing
- CRM for contact management
- Automation
- Web forms and landing pages
- Transactional emails


**Why it’s suitable for startups:** All-in-one approach with flexible pricing makes it startup-friendly.


**Customer feedback and support:** Known for responsive support and reliable delivery.


**Startup ranking:** 4.5/5 – Best value all-rounder.


### 3. ActiveCampaign


ActiveCampaign offers advanced automation and CRM, allowing restaurants to create targeted loyalty campaigns and track customer engagement. It’s especially useful for scaling multi-location strategies.


**Pricing:** Starts at $9/month; Plus and Professional plans for more features.


**Ease of use:** Slight learning curve, but powerful once familiar.


**Features:**


- Deep automation flows
- Customer lifecycle tracking
- CRM and lead scoring
- Segmentation and personalization
- SMS marketing


**Why it’s suitable for startups:** Ideal for scaling campaigns and managing customer journeys.


**Customer feedback and support:** Strong reviews for functionality; support praised but some onboarding complexity.


**Startup ranking:** 4.4/5 – Best for data-driven growth.


### 4. Mailchimp


Mailchimp is one of the most widely used platforms due to its intuitive design and excellent set of tools for beginners. It’s ideal for restaurants starting email campaigns for promotions and bookings.


**Pricing:**


- Free plan available at $0/month for up to 500 contacts
- Essentials at starting at $13/month for 500 contacts
- Standard at starting at $20/month for 500 contacts
- Premium at starting at $350/month for 10,000 contacts


**Ease of use:** One of the easiest platforms to learn.


**Features:**


- Email builder with templates
- Automation flows
- Sign-up forms
- Audience insights
- Integrations with POS and booking tools


**Why it’s suitable for startups:** Low-cost entry with powerful tools for growth.


**Customer feedback and support:** Great for beginners; support scales with plan level.


**Startup ranking:** 4.3/5 – Ideal for small to medium-sized eateries.


### 5. Omnisend


Omnisend supports email, SMS, and push notifications, making it perfect for restaurants that want multichannel outreach. It's especially helpful for online ordering or delivery-driven businesses.


**Pricing:**


- Free plan available at $0/month for up to 500 contacts and 6,000 emails/month
- Standard at $11.20/month, best for growing and medium-sized businesses
- Pro at $41.30/month, ideal for high-volume senders using SMS
- Enterprise at custom pricing for large-scale needs and high contact volume


**Ease of use:** Clear UI, with customizable automation templates.


**Features:**


- SMS + Email + Push
- Drag-and-drop builder
- Cart abandonment and welcome flows
- Product recommendations
- Integrations with eCommerce platforms


**Why it’s suitable for startups:** Especially beneficial for hybrid restaurants with online ordering.


**Customer feedback and support:** Strong support and onboarding experience.


**Startup ranking:** 4.2/5 – Best for multichannel outreach.


### 6. AWeber


AWeber is a long-trusted email platform known for simplicity and reliable delivery. It’s great for restaurants that want straightforward campaigns and branded newsletters.


**Pricing:**


- Lite plan available at $12.50/month (billed annually)
- Plus plan at $20/month (billed annually)
- Unlimited at $899/month for unlimited subscribers


**Ease of use:** Great for non-tech-savvy users.


**Features:**


- Email automation
- Sign-up forms
- Analytics dashboard
- Template library
- RSS-to-email


**Why it’s suitable for startups:** Simplicity and support stand out for lean teams.


**Customer feedback and support:** Renowned for excellent customer service.


**Startup ranking:** 4.1/5 – Reliable and straightforward.


### 7. Moosend


Moosend is a cost-effective solution with robust automation and personalization features. It’s ideal for restaurants that want smart, automated campaigns on a budget.


**Pricing:** Starts at $9/month after free trial.


**Ease of use:** Clean interface with no-frills design.


**Features:**


- Automation flows
- Landing page builder
- AI-driven recommendations
- Email personalization
- Advanced reporting


**Why it’s suitable for startups:** Affordable pricing with essential tools for conversion.


**Customer feedback and support:** Consistently praised for value and simplicity.


**Startup ranking:** 4.0/5 – Affordable with high potential.


### 8. EngageBay


EngageBay combines CRM, sales, and marketing tools into one platform. It's particularly good for local restaurants that also need basic CRM and customer tracking.


**Pricing:**


- Free plan available at $0 per user/month
- Basic plan available at $12.74 per user/month
- Growth plan available at $55.24 per user/month
- Pro plan available at $101.99 per user/month


**Ease of use:** Unified dashboard with helpful onboarding.


**Features:**


- Email marketing + CRM
- Landing pages
- Forms and pop-ups
- Automation workflows
- Helpdesk & live chat


**Why it’s suitable for startups:** One of the best budget options for full-stack marketing.


**Customer feedback and support:** Great value; strong reviews for support.


**Startup ranking:** 3.9/5 – Good for multi-use platforms.


### 9. MailerLite


MailerLite is a clean, user-friendly platform offering just the right amount of tools for cafés and solo restaurateurs. It’s especially great for campaigns like newsletters and daily specials.


**Pricing:**


- Essentials plan available for free; limit of 500 contacts
- Premium at $350/month for 10,000 contacts
- Standard at $20/month for 500 contacts
- Best value at $13/month for 500 contacts


**Ease of use:** Streamlined interface, ideal for solo entrepreneurs.


**Features:**


- Drag-and-drop builder
- Automation
- Forms and landing pages
- A/B testing
- Integrations with booking platforms


**Why it’s suitable for startups:** Great for solo or first-time marketers.


**Customer feedback and support:** Strong ratings for usability and affordability.


**Startup ranking:** 3.8/5 – Minimalist and beginner-friendly.


### 10. GetResponse


GetResponse is a flexible marketing platform that combines email, webinars, and landing pages. It's great for event-driven campaigns like cooking classes, menu launches, or local promotions.


**Pricing:**


- Free plan available at $0/month with 30-day premium trial included
- Starter at $19/month or $15.58/month if paid annually
- Marketer at $59/month or $48.38/month if paid annually
- Creator at $69/month or $56.58/month if paid annually
- Enterprise at custom pricing based on business needs


**Ease of use:** Slightly more advanced; better for marketers with experience.


**Features:**


- Email builder and automation
- Landing page creator
- CRM
- Webinars
- Audience segmentation


**Why it’s suitable for startups:** Best suited for growth-driven campaigns or multiple locations.


**Customer feedback and support:** Reliable, with a comprehensive support library.


**Startup ranking:** 3.7/5 – Full-featured suite for high-intent strategies.


## Final thoughts


Choosing the right email marketing software for your restaurant can feel overwhelming, but the good news is most of these platforms offer free trials or entry-level plans. Whether you're running a cozy café or managing multiple locations, there's a solution that fits your goals, team size, and budget.


Our advice? Test. Sign up for free trials, explore their templates, send a few campaigns, and see what feels intuitive for your workflow. Every restaurant is different, and the best platform for you is the one that aligns with how you connect with your guests.


Try a few, compare the results, and choose the one that helps you drive reservations, promote specials, and build loyal customers—on your terms.
